case.title: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.. Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red. Need: 15900 pc a year. Category goal: quality first: defects and late deliveries cost more than a few cents of price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 58 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200011. message.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
message.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

You wrote that you are eager to prove yourselves as a long-term partner. Our options give you the chance to do that on quality, where the real work in this enquiry lies.

On quality:
Your quality was 2376 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70140@2026Q3).

On price history:
Our orders of Bearing bracket HN with you were placed at EUR 46.33 on 2024-10-18 (po:4500011561-10), EUR 46.33 on 2025-06-20 (po:4500012598-10), EUR 45.15 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013441-20) and EUR 45.15 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014429-10): the price has not risen.

Against that record, your offer does not fit. We have therefore set out three options, each with no chargeback per complaint, so that a better quality commitment is rewarded with a clear price.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: quality commitment 1,500 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 39.85.
Option B: quality commitment 800 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 40.18.
Option C: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 40.41.

Option A is the package we can approve: it pairs a quality commitment that is realistic against your current record with a price in line with what we have paid so far. Options B and C are there if you prefer to commit to tighter quality.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
message.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
message.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Also, we checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We value our cooperation and have made a step towards you. 

Our offer is a price of €47.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 1500 ppm: €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
